label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 15 balance confirmed four more deaths, raising the toll to 335 — the first change since Aug 25, breaking a three-week plateau at 331.

label: Injured
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 15 balance revised injured up slightly to 4,516, from 4,505 in the Sept 7 balance.

label: Missing
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 15 balance narrowed missing further to 105 — down from 111 on Sept 7 — as identification work continues.

label: Families Affected
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 15 balance recorded 486,917 people affected across 303,934 families in 500 municipios and 16 departments — up from 296,738 families on Sept 7.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 15 balance cited 36,478 homes destroyed (up from 36,326 on Sept 7) and 206,931 damaged (up from 202,002), across 500 municipios, with 758 buildings collapsed and 6,047 further buildings damaged — plus 397 health centers and 4,316 schools affected.

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Holding at 16 departments in UNGRD's Sept 15 balance, but the municipio count widened to 500 (from 498 on Sept 7); which department was added beyond Decree 1261's original 15 remains unclarified.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: A joint UNDP-UNGRD damage assessment published Aug 30 put total direct physical damage at COP 42.1 trillion (2.3% of GDP) — COP 37.4T in housing and COP 4.8T in health, education and community infrastructure — up from the government's earlier COP 30T preliminary estimate. On Sept 17, PNUD's regional director for Latin America and the Caribbean, Michelle Muschett, cited a separate initial UNDP figure of roughly $14 billion — above the government's own $9.5B estimate for the three-phase 'Plan Milagro' reconstruction effort. Independent estimates still range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP).

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: SGC's one-month review (Sept 10, coordinator Freddy Tovar) split the tally into 300+ aftershocks beyond 70km depth directly tied to the mainshock, plus a separate 1,200+ event shallow swarm (under 70km) near Istmina/Sipí. El Tiempo cited a combined sequence total of 1,300+ events as of Sept 12. Activity has continued since with fresh clusters near Istmina, Sipí, Andagoya and Medio San Juan on Sept 14, 16, 18 and 19 (largest M4.9), so the true current total is higher — SGC has not published a newer aggregate figure.

label: Chocó 'Plan Marshall' Reconstruction Pledge
contestNote: COP 2T private-sector pledge + COP 1T government infrastructure package, announced at the Sept 7 Quibdó business summit. Several English-language outlets initially overstated the government's COP 1T share as 'US$1 billion' (actually ~$320M) — a 'billón' translation error corrected by Rio Times Online on Sept 8.

label: Reconstruction Decrees Signed
contestNote: President de la Espriella signed 11 decrees on Sept 9 to accelerate reconstruction, centered on Decree 1379 creating the Fondo Patria Milagro trust fund, plus one-time Fonpet pension-reserve use, Fondes energy-infrastructure repairs, an 'obras por impuestos' tax-offset mechanism, exceptional DANE data access and school-continuity flexibility.
